firstPlayerRule: Randomly choose the Master Builder, who begins by arranging the rooms and setting their prices. The player on the Master Builder’s left gets the first buying turn.
clarifications: Buying proceeds clockwise, with the Master Builder buying last. Pass the Master Builder token left for the next round.
The setup suggests spinning the Master Builder token to choose its first holder.
